name: lockyaw.voicechat
description: Native Netcode for GameObjects voice communication for client-server and distributed-authority topologies, with authority-routed conversation groups, area microphones, channel-based radios and public-address speakers, Opus encoding, spatial and global playback, and guided setup.

samples.description: Proximity chat, global chat, and push-to-talk.
Walkie-talkies that relay nearby sound on matching frequencies, plus a button-operated microphone connected to several world speakers.
A client-server network prefab that connects through Steam IDs.
A reskinnable uGUI prefab for changing each player's voice volume.
Reusable UI Toolkit controls for changing each player's voice volume.
